title: Water for Energy & Industry chart contracts

contracts.title: Data-center direct water, 2023 estimate and 2028 range
constraints: Projection range is a source scenario, not a forecast.
Do not assign the national estimate or range to a facility.

contracts.title: Direct and indirect data-center water remain separate
constraints: Indirect electricity water is an attributed upstream footprint.
Do not add it to national totals that already include the power sector.

contracts.title: Thermoelectric withdrawal is not consumption
constraints: Keep freshwater withdrawal and consumptive use separate.
Do not assign national averages to a plant or watershed.

contracts.title: Facility, utility, energy, and watershed system
constraints: Show source, season, return flow, quality, and power dependencies.
A physically present source is not necessarily operationally available.

contracts.title: Siting and drought-operating scorecard
constraints: Scores describe required decision evidence, not facility performance.
No national average may clear a local siting gate.

contracts.title: Verified facility water and watershed map
constraints: Keep unavailable until facility, source, seasonal, utility, return-flow, and discharge data are verified.
